job.job_description:
Experience: 5 to 13 years

Location: Hyderabad

Primary Skills: Agentic AI Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong, hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions and microservices-based applications.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across the stack — from backend services to automated deployment pipelines — and will bring practical experience applying agentic AI frameworks to real-world application workflows.

Key Responsibilities

•      Design, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using Python, Django, and FastAPI.

•      Build, containerize, and deploy applications using modern container technologies.

•      Implement and manage automation and CI/CD pipelines to streamline build, test, and release cycles.

•      Apply agentic AI frameworks to design and build intelligent, autonomous application workflows.

•      Design and expose REST APIs for integration with other systems and services.

•      Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and troubleshooting of production issues.

•      Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

•      At least 5 to 6 years of relevant, hands-on experience in full stack / microservices development (6 to 8 years overall experience preferred).

•      Strong hands-on experience with Python, Django, and FastAPI.

•      Practical experience building and deploying containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes).

•      Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD / automation pipelines.

•      Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar).

•      Solid understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns.

•      Experience with REST API design and integration.

•      Good working knowledge of Git and standard software engineering practices.

•      Cloud knowledge AWS

Good to Have

•      Experience with front-end frameworks (React/Angular) for full-stack delivery.

•      Exposure to LLM-based application development.
